text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-45271 — rate-limiter-service "high_429_rate" in us-east-1. Aggregated 5xx/429 spike, rolling 5m error rate 18%. Auto-page to oncall: sam. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC-45271

pagerduty: Incident INC-45271 created (priority P1). Acknowledge to stop escalation. Triggering service: rate-limiter-service. Triggering check: perf/rate-limiter/response-codes.

sam: acked. Pulling up dashboards now. Anyone seeing recent deploys to rate-limiter in us-east?

maya: i just noticed a canary rolled earlier but should be in canary-only. checking deploy history...

leo: logs show a rapid increase in token bucket rejections from quota-enforcer: `quota_check::deny` spiking at 11:02 UTC. Could be policy misapply.

sam: good catch. can you paste the top log lines and which policy id?

leo: pasted snippet from kibana:
```
2026-02-25T11:01:58Z quota-enforcer[pid=2134] INFO policy_apply policy_id=Q-2026-128 user=service_proxy result=applied
2026-02-25T11:02:03Z quota-enforcer WARN check user=svc_api token=abc... result=deny rule_id=rateburst-50s
2026-02-25T11:02:10Z proxy WARN upstream request 429 host=api.hosted.redwood region=us-east-1
```

maya: that `policy_id=Q-2026-128` corresponds to a new quota rollout that was supposed to be limited to internal-testing. looks like rollout target tag mismatch.

opsbot: runbook step 1: verify scope. runbook step 2: isolate impacted traffic. runbook step 3: apply temporary bypass.

sam: ok plan — 1) open temporary bypass for quota-enforcer in us-east for prod-routes (10m) 2) scale rate-limiter pods by +2 3) rollback quota rollout to previous stable. Who can execute bypass?

maya: i'll apply the bypass and bump pods. doing rancher patch now.

rachel-cs: heads up — customer-impact: a few mid-market customers reported throttled requests for inference calls ~11:02-11:12; Support ticket #7892 incoming. I'll triage and notify affected accounts once we have scope.

sam: thanks rachel. make note: don't promise ETA until we have mitigation.

maya: applying bypass rule: `PATCH /v1/policies/Q-2026-128` -> set `target_tags: [internal-testing]` and `enabled: false` for rollout. command:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://control-plane.internal/policies/Q-2026-128" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"enabled": false}'
```

opsbot: action executed by maya at 11:07 UTC: policy Q-2026-128 disabled in us-east.

leo: confirming metrics — 429 rate dropped from 18% -> 3% in the next 90s. latency for short requests back to baseline.

sam: nice. scaling limiter now to absorb backlog: `kubectl scale deploy/rate-limiter --replicas=10 -n infra-us-east`

maya: scaled to 10. observed reconnections from downstream proxies.

prod-monitor: automated check: service latency normalized, error budget usage decreasing. Post-mitigation health: ok.

sam: good. summary for PD incident: mitigation applied (disabled mis-scoped quota rollout + scaled limiter), immediate customer impact limited to a 10-minute window for a subset of customers. Next steps: create postmortem, add stricter rollout-scoping checks, revert rollout gating to require two approvals.

rachel-cs: i'm drafting customer messages for those affected; will coordinate with coms.

leo: quick note — investigating how Q-2026-128 targeted prod route. initial suspicion: a tag collision where `environment: staging` vs `env: staging` mismatch in the control plane caused default fallthrough to prod. creating a short PR for validation.

maya: handing off to on-call for follow-up. sam: do you want to remain incident commander or pass?

sam: i'm handing off. maya is IC for follow-up items, i'm going offline to join a customer call. maya please assign scribe.

maya: i'll take IC. leo, you scribe?

leo: on it. recording notes and will create ticket INT-2987 for RCA.

opsbot: escalation timer cleared. PagerDuty incident will remain open for postmortem until resolved.

pagerduty: Incident INC-45271 acknowledged by sam at 11:05 UTC. Current status: mitigated. Please update incident timeline and close once RCA complete. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC-45271

sam: :thumbsup: thanks team. quick checklist for RCA: - root cause: mis-scoped quota rollout - blast radius: us-east prod routes - immediate remediation: disabled policy, scaled limiter - action items: rollout validation test, require 2 approvals, add canary traffic isolation, run simulated quota-change test in staging.

rachel-cs: will follow up with affected customers with an admin note and timeline.

leo: logging note: export logs for 10:58-11:12 window to S3 -> s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-45271.log.gz

maya: creating postmortem doc and copying owners. I'll link here when ready.

sam: closing loop — if anything regresses ping immediately. great work. :tada:
